headline: BRIXTON METALS BLASTS 1,975 G/T SILVER OVER 4M AT LANGIS — THIRD DRILL RIG ADDED AS 2026 PROGRAM TOPS 40,000M
snippet: Brixton Metals (TSXV: BBB) released 28 holes from Langis, Ontario including 1,975 g/t silver over 4m within 23.5m at 348 g/t in Hole 449. A third drill rig has been added as the company surpasses 40,000 metres drilled in 2026.

headline: GOLD EDGES TO $4,164 AS ICE LAUNCHES FUTURES TRADING IN LONDON'S $190 BILLION PHYSICAL GOLD MARKET
snippet: Gold rose $24.60 to $4,164.10/oz Tuesday as ICE brought futures trading to London's $190 billion-a-day physical gold market. Central banks added a net 39 tonnes in August with China, Uzbekistan, and Poland leading purchases.

headline: BOTH WORLD'S TOP COPPER MINES FACE SIMULTANEOUS STRIKES — CENTINELA OCT. 13 DEADLINE, ESCONDIDA SUPERVISORS 95% VOTE YES
snippet: Supervisors at BHP's Escondida — the world's only 1-million-tonne copper mine — voted 95% in favour of strike after rejecting a contract offer and entering mandatory government mediation. Simultaneously, Antofagasta's Centinela (240,400 mt/y) faces an October 13 strike date if mediation fails.

headline: SEOUL TARGETS $120B IN EIGHT U.S. NUCLEAR REACTORS — THE DECADE'S LARGEST SINGLE URANIUM DEMAND CATALYST
snippet: South Korea is leaning toward committing $120 billion to eight new reactors in the United States — at least two built by Korean firms, at least two by American ones — as part of Seoul's broader $350 billion U.S. investment pledge. The plan averages $15 billion per reactor.

headline: ATOMIC EAGLE HITS 86% URANIUM RECOVERY AT MUNTANGA EAST ON JUST 3 KG/T ACID — HEAP LEACH CASE CONFIRMED IN ZAMBIA
snippet: Atomic Eagle (ASX: AEU) delivered 81–86% uranium recoveries from low-grade core at Muntanga East using just ~3 kg/t of acid, confirming the viability of a heap leach development path for its Zambian project.

headline: OLYMPIO METALS FINDS UNRECORDED MINE TUNNEL AT JACKNIFE SILVER — COULD EXTEND CONJECTURE SHEAR ZONE BY 500M
snippet: Olympio Metals (ASX: OLY) discovered an unrecorded historical adit at Idaho's Jacknife Silver Project that could add ~500 metres to the Conjecture Shear Zone. The zone hosts a foreign estimate of 8.22 Moz silver at 405 g/t, with maiden drilling underway and assays expected within weeks.

headline: AMERICAS GOLD & SILVER GALENA DRILLING BEATS RESOURCE GRADES — NEW 1,061 G/T SILVER VEIN INTERCEPT AHEAD OF 2027 ESTIMATE UPDATE
snippet: Americas Gold & Silver (TSX: USA) infill drilling at Galena, Cosalá, and Crescent is outperforming existing resource models across all three operations. At Galena's 49 level, a new vein graded 1,061 g/t silver, 0.7% copper, and 0.6% antimony — above minimum mining width and ahead of the 2027 resource update.

headline: JAPAN'S GOLD COMEBACK: THE EXPLORER DRILLING A PROVINCE THAT ONCE FUNDED AN EMPIRE
snippet: As Japan ends decades of gold exploration stagnation, one junior is drilling epithermal targets across Hokkaido and Honshu — historically the world's most under-explored tier-one gold jurisdiction. The piece argues structural geology and permitting reforms make this the sector's next re-rating opportunity.

headline: CRITICAL METALS COMMITS $30M TO ADVANCE TANBREEZ — GREENLAND'S $3B HEAVY RARE EARTH PROJECT TARGETS PRODUCTION BY 2028
snippet: Critical Metals (NASDAQ: CRML) approved a $30 million program to advance Tanbreez in southern Greenland, one of the world's largest undeveloped heavy rare earth deposits outside China, valued at ~$3 billion in a preliminary economic assessment. Initial production of ~85,000 tpa REO scales to 425,000 tpa with concentrate exports targeted for Q3 2029.

headline: BRAZIL COURT IDLES SIGMA LITHIUM'S GROTA DO CIRILO — ANALYSTS SAY SUPPLY TIGHTENING EFFECT IS IMMEDIATE
snippet: A Brazilian judge suspended mining and processing at Sigma Lithium's Grota do Cirilo complex, citing the project's proximity to a protected Quilombola community. Sigma halted all operations and is appealing; Benchmark Minerals says the shutdown could tighten near-term spodumene supply given Sigma's 330,000-tonne annual concentrate capacity.

headline: LYNAS BIDS A$968M ($672M USD) FOR METEORIC RESOURCES — GAINS ACCESS TO BRAZIL'S LARGEST IONIC CLAY RARE EARTH PROJECT
snippet: Lynas Rare Earths is acquiring Meteoric Resources in a 68%-premium all-share deal to gain Brazil's Caldeira Project — the largest known ionic clay JORC REE resource outside China, with a 23-year mine life. Lynas shares fell 6.4% as markets questioned feedstock integration risk.
